title: Lead Data Engineer (Data Governance & Compliance)
jobDescription:
Nissan is a pioneer in Innovation and Technology. With a focus on Mobility, Operational Excellence, Value to our Customers and Electrification of vehicles, you can expect to be part of a very exciting journey here at Nissan. Nissan is going after a massive Digital Transformation backed by leading technologies across the organization globally. We are committed to building a diverse, entrepreneurial organization, and our current team is a strong evidence of that. Our people are what drive the business forward. At Nissan Digital, you will be part of a dynamic team with ample opportunities to grow and make a difference. Role Overview Nissan’s AMIEO region is accelerating the maturity of its data governance and regulatory readiness across domains such as vehicle data, aftersales, supply chain, and customer experience. This role is central to enabling Nissan’s ability to meet enterprise-wide data quality standards, comply with evolving EU and global regulations, and embed policy-driven data practices into digital operations. As part of a lean, outcome-oriented team, the consultant will act as a functional and coordination lead across data quality, policy definition, and regulatory assurance. This is a value-driven role, not a heavy commercial engagement, and will work closely with Nissan’s internal experts, legal, and business owners to deliver measurable improvements without requiring high consulting overheads. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. Data Quality Management Define, refine, and institutionalize enterprise-wide data quality standards (accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness). Design and roll out data quality scorecards and dashboards aligned to AMIEO business KPIs. Drive root-cause analysis and remediation workflows in coordination with business data owners and stewards. Establish a sustainable issue management and escalation framework for recurring quality gaps.
2. Policy & Standards Development Support the creation and continuous improvement of Nissan’s enterprise data policies (e.g. privacy, lifecycle management, metadata handling). Embed governance checkpoints and policies into digital delivery and transformation frameworks. Design simple playbooks, guides, and training sessions to enhance awareness and adoption of data best practices across functions. Collaborate with central data governance teams in Japan and other regions to ensure harmonization and avoid redundancy.
3. Regulatory & Compliance Readiness Support Nissan’s implementation of EU Data Act, GDPR, and upcoming AI Act across applicable use cases (e.g. vehicle data sharing, AI model traceability). Liaise with Nissan’s legal, audit, and risk functions to map responsibilities and action plans. Assist in maintaining Nissan’s compliance posture: create documentation, audit support, and breach preparedness materials. Help define compliant data-sharing processes with third parties, partners, and regulators, especially in relation to vehicle, user, and telemetry data. Key Qualifications 6–10 years of experience in data governance, regulatory compliance, or data quality roles, ideally within automotive, manufacturing, or tech sectors. Familiarity with frameworks such as DAMA-DMBOK, ISO 8000, EU Data Act, GDPR, and AI governance frameworks. Good understanding of modern data architecture—ideally AWS, Snowflake, Microsoft Purview/Fabric. Proven track record of working in cross-functional environments with business, legal, and data teams. Comfortable operating in lean, high-accountability roles with limited external dependencies Trivandrum Kerala India Nissan is more than a car company. We are an innovation company. Role Overview The role is responsible for leading the analysis of business data needs and shaping data-driven solutions that deliver measurable value aligned with the organization’s medium-term plan (MTP). This position oversees the enterprise data visualization landscape, manages operational data support activities, and drives strategic planning across the data portfolio. Working closely with senior leadership, data architecture teams, and global counterparts, the role ensures effective governance, optimal resource utilization, and alignment with global data capabilities. The individual will play a key role in enabling seamless data sharing, improving operational efficiency, and ensuring that the data function effectively supports business objectives across AMIEO regions. Key Responsibilities Lead the analysis of business data demand and plan data solutions that support business outcomes and deliver benefits in line with the MTP. Oversee the data visualization ecosystem, including tools such as Tableau and Power BI, managing licensing, budgeting, and strategic direction. Own Data Support Operations, with the vendor support lead reporting directly into this function. Collaborate with the GM, managers, and Data Architecture teams to build the roadmap for the data domain and manage the associated project portfolio. Act as the Data Resourcing Lead, working closely with Accenture on River governance and performance optimization initiatives. Ensure alignment with Global IS and partner with leadership to maximize the use of NDI capabilities for AMIEO regions, including initiatives like cross-regional data sharing. Skills and
